title: Uruguayan Goat Meat Casserole
description: A hearty pungent casserole from Uruguay, featuring tender goat meat, crunchy vegetables and a silky bechamel sauce. This recipe is perfect for a cozy dinner on a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chopped onion, carrots, and celery and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the goat meat to the skillet and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the bechamel sauce to the skillet and stir to combine with the goat meat and vegetables.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with half of the grated cheddar cheese.
In a separate bowl, beat the eggs and season with salt and black pepper. Pour the egg mixture over the goat meat mixture and top with the remaining cheddar cheese.
Drizzle the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil over the top of the casserole and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the cheese is melted and golden brown.
